accepted.title: Propagate controlled-memory Matroska packet-index and metadata ceilings (max_controlled_bytes / size_of::<Packet>()) across Matroska identity remux, Matroska subtitle conversion, sample-domain audio concat, and multitrack MP4 export
accepted.summary: Clamps Matroska Limits::packets to max_controlled_bytes / size_of::<Packet>() and maps clamped packet-count refusals to "controlled memory budget exceeded: Matroska packet index limit" in owned_matroska_copy_impl::inspect_with_packet_and_memory_limits, owned_subtitle_impl::try_plan_with_controls and try_convert_matroska_inner, native_audio_mix::concat::segment_packet_count, and owned_mp4_multitrack_export::try_export, and forwards options.max_controlled_bytes to extract_source_pcm_metadata_with_interval_packet_and_memory_limit in concat_audio_with_options.
